Application Data.NAME: Java Bean Caf\u00e9
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Java Bean Caf\u00e9 operates as a cozy coffee shop and tea house, offering a variety of specialty coffees, teas, and freshly baked pastries. We pride ourselves on creating a welcoming atmosphere for our customers to enjoy their beverages and socialize. Our operations include brewing high-quality coffee, serving a diverse selection of teas, and preparing light snacks. Safety is a priority, and we maintain our equipment to minimize fire hazards. We do not serve alcohol or host live entertainment, and our facility is under 7,500 sq ft, ensuring compliance with fire safety standards. Seasonal closures are avoided, as we remain open year-round to serve our community.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a small fire occurred due to an electrical fault in our espresso machine, resulting in damage to the equipment and surrounding areas. The total cost of repairs was $5,000.00. The claim status is currently closed as we have completed all necessary repairs and preventive measures.

Final Reason: The business is rejected due to having a history of a fire-related claim, which violates specific underwriting exclusions for this type of business.
Underwriting Guidelines:
– Alcohol-focused businesses: Establishments primarily operating as bars or pubs with
significant alcohol sales or promotions.
– Live entertainment: Venues hosting live music, DJs, or other performances that in-
crease noise, crowd size, and potential for property damage or liability claims.
– Seasonal closures: Businesses that close for more than 30 consecutive days per year,
increasing risk of undetected property damage, vandalism, or fire.
– Large venues or inadequate fire controls: Facilities exceeding 7,500 sq ft or seating
over 150 without documented fire safety measures, including absence of sprinklers or fire
alarms.
